_readme: When AstroHour asks for a donation.
A date is written MM-DD. On its own it means the start of the first
Jupiter-ruled day hour, which is derived from sunrise where the user is,
so everyone gets the card in their own morning. To pin a wall-clock time
instead, give a time and an IANA zone: { "on": "09-02", "at": "08:00 America/New_York" }.
"years" fully replaces the date list for that year. Years not listed use
"default". An empty list means no reminders that year.
